method.application: Compare existing Module Interface/lifetime with newly integrated shared reader; reuse one codec and existing authorization rather than adding parallel state/transport. Read-only analysis, no installation/product run.

facts.finding: nativeActivityBodyPages performs zero HTTP but eagerly allocates descriptor.bytes via Uint8Array, up to 8MiB. Reserve the UI retention budget before constructing, not merely before readNext.

One page at a time, max four chunks; immutable identity and complete digest verified by shared codec. completeText caches another full string only after complete verification; returned page chunks are caller-owned copies. close aborts lifetime and releases held byte/text references; it does not promise physical secure erasure or immediate GC/RSS reduction.

Current old-prefix DTO bodies map retains each loaded body until projection disposal. setActive(false)/page change abort work but retain old bodies; no full-material aggregate reservation. Cannot place many 8MiB readers in this cache unchanged.
Row collapse only clears React expanded ID, does not notify projection to close material. JSON body is eagerly JSON.parse/stringified and mounted in one pre; unsuitable for future full 8MiB material.

Existing connection/view/conversation/turn/task/message identity, visible/live lease and task.activity.read/reference.read authorization already own access. Current bridge still uses legacy client.nativeActivity(id), not the new task/activity descriptor and pages.

consumerDesign.module: Existing authorized Activity host + one private material controller
consumerDesign.interface: Explicit open(row), read-next/refresh, close; observable display state. Shared client remains sole codec/cursor/integrity authority.
consumerDesign.ownership: Host reserves before constructor and wraps every read with current identity/capability checks before and after await; do not hand a raw reusable FlowClient reader to contributed views. Controller releases reader/reservation on row replacement/collapse/page change/pane hidden/offline/logout/center or principal change/plugin capability revoke/dispose.

consumerDesign.module: NativeActivity view inside existing assistant-ui Reasoning / AI Elements Tool
consumerDesign.interface: Display verified status and one bounded text window; explicit load next/current-tail refresh; narrow content details.
consumerDesign.ownership: Keep tool/task status distinct from material partial/complete/interrupted/legacy. Receiving + hasMore=false is a temporary tail, not a terminal cache. Legacy honestly reports unavailable original tail. Hidden thinking remains redacted.

consumerDesign.interface: Small reservation/release seam internal to activity host; no independent authority for business state.
consumerDesign.ownership: Permit complete retrieval of at least one full-contract 8MiB body; account raw reservation, optional decoded text, caller chunk copies, page transport and DOM window across multiple panes/turns. Numeric aggregate policy is a proposal to validate, not an existing approved limit or a claim of hard JS heap bound. Do not truncate capability to old 2MiB cache.

consumerDesign.interface: Incremental UTF8 decoder for verified pages, or one complete decode after digest; bounded paginated/windowed text.
consumerDesign.ownership: Do not JSON.parse intermediate pages or every full-prefix update. Avoid automatic huge pretty-print; explicit bounded formatting only. Keep raw integrity distinct from rendering and support split multi-byte UTF8 boundaries.

acceptanceForOriginalSuccessor: True App/plugin bridge and two panes, not only standalone reader tests. Unopened list and SSE make zero body requests.
Explicit open fetches descriptor then page; zero reader allocation before budget admission; two 8MiB descriptors cannot bypass aggregate bound.
Collapse/switch row/hide pane/revoke/logout cancel current read, close/release and prevent late UI publish or next HTTP; reopen is explicit.
Receiving tail can later advance via explicit refresh; interrupted/legacy remain truthful.
Real UTF8 material greater than 2MiB plus contract-size boundary, exact original length/digest through shared reader; no surrogate/byte-boundary corruption.
Fail/abort/bad page preserves prior committed cursor and readable data; retry explicit; complete material never marks task verified/success.
Plaintext escaping, narrow screen, keyboard/focus, light/dark and reduced motion through existing registered contribution.
Record logical reservations and actual render/page limits, distinguish bounded algorithm/source reasoning from measured performance.
